subject.title: build(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group with 9 updates

question: Should this grouped production dependency upgrade land as one batch, or should maintainers split higher-risk runtime/native-rendering packages into smaller PRs?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and green, but it changes multiple production runtime/build dependencies whose compatibility impact is a maintainer-owned merge-risk judgment.

options.title: Land grouped upgrade
options.body: Accept the compatibility risk as covered by the current CI, preview, and smoke checks, then merge the Dependabot batch.

options.title: Split higher-risk packages
options.body: Ask for separate updates for Convex, Sharp, and markdown-rendering packages if maintainers want easier rollback and attribution.

options.title: Hold for extra manual smoke
options.body: Pause merge until a maintainer exercises the production-critical pages or flows they consider most sensitive.

recommendation.title: Land grouped upgrade
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility risk as covered by the current CI, preview, and smoke checks, then merge the Dependabot batch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent dependency/package-maintenance history and CODEOWNERS routing make this the clearest individual owner for the compatibility choice.
